bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PAXG is now covered as issuer-native on Ethereum and Solana, while the Ethereum-side LayerZero adapter is authored here as bridge machinery rather than global native Mint Authority. Paxos documents Ethereum-to-Solana movement through its platform or LayerZero Stargate, and the adapter has a current owner, implementation, bridge-mint/burn capacity, and rate limit. The exact LayerZero endpoint/OApp peers, DVN/validator set, current rate-limit state, burn/mint supply-conservation invariant, and Solana mint-authority attribution remain unresolved, so the route assessment is intentionally opaque-or-unknown rather than external-validated-network.

routes.reviewNote: PAXG is natively issued on Ethereum through Paxos SupplyControl. The canonical-side LayerZero adapter ingress/egress capability and rate limit are separately recorded in the bridge control below and do not change this route's native issuance model.

Paxos calls this a Solana-native Token-2022 deployment and the official PAXG site links the mint. W07 (2026-08-18, slot 440115731) confirmed independent native issuance: mint authority is a 1-of-4 Token-2022 multisig with Paxos admin 2apBGM…, two 177k/50s Paxos minter-controller PDAs, and LayerZero OFT store CdxPHbQ…. Native MintToken without LayerZero is observed; OFT LzReceive is an additional burn/mint transfer rail already covered by structured bridge controls. issuanceModel stays native-issuance. Remaining bridge opacity is peer/DVN/current rate-limit state, not mint-authority attribution.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Paxos documents LayerZero Stargate as a PAXG bridge path, but the PAXG-specific endpoint/OApp peer and remote-token configuration were not enumerated.
routeChecks.rateLimits: At Ethereum block 25526129, the adapter was an active SupplyController with a 13,320-PAXG capacity and 0.155-PAXG-per-second refill. The current post-block-25526129 rate-limit state was not re-read.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25770003, adapter implementation was 0xc54ca36efe594e4c774ba8463adf67ba3de1236f and owner() was 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b. The exact endpoint/DVN/validator and route pause/upgrade administrator graph remains unresolved.

controls.capDescription: The adapter's bridge SupplyController capacity and refill are distinct from the two native Paxos controller capacities; the controller-manager EOA can change adapter membership and limits immediately.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, PAXG SupplyControl getAllSupplyControllerAddresses() included adapter proxy 0xd09ede557ef195983c9544a5724046fbd6e8a3c6, whose configuration had 13,320 PAXG capacity and 0.155 PAXG-per-second refill. At block 25770003, the adapter implementation resolved to 0xc54ca36efe594e4c774ba8463adf67ba3de1236f and owner() returned controller-manager EOA 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b. This is canonical-side bridge machinery and is not included in the native Mint Authority controls.

controls.label: PAXG Solana LayerZero OFT store

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: InitOft + RegisterOapp at slot 421037033 registered this store as an OApp on LayerZero Solana endpoint 76y77prsiCMvXMjuoZ5VRrhG5qYBrUMYTE5WgHqgjEn6. Aave's 2026-07-17 PAXG technical assessment says the Ethereum OFT has a single Solana peer and required DVNs LayerZero Labs, Canary, and Paxos. This review did not re-decode the Solana store's peer bytes or re-read Ethereum peers().
routeChecks.rateLimits: The OFT store is a threshold-one mint-authority signer and has no Token-2022 supply cap. Ethereum-side adapter capacity 13,320 PAXG / 0.155-per-second remains on paxg-ethereum-layerzero-adapter. Aave reported an inbound bound of about 4,440 PAXG per 24 hours as of 2026-07-17; that bound was not re-read on 2026-08-18.

At slot 439966894 an LzReceive on paxosVkYu cleared a message via that endpoint and mintTo'd 4.505618 PAXG with only CdxPHbQ as the Token-2022 multisig signer. PayPal's PYUSD LayerZero guide uses the same program-id paxosVkYu… for lz:oft:solana:send. This is destination-side OFT machinery on a native Token-2022 mint, not the only Solana issuance path.
